label: Clean Slate
summary: A fixer offers a job that would wipe out your debt: steal back a memory a corporation took. The memory has your name on it.
title: Clean Slate
description: A fixer offers you a job that pays enough to erase your debt: steal back a memory a corporation took from someone. The file has your name on it.

chapterOutlines.title: The Offer
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the fixer and take, or refuse, the job.

chapterOutlines.title: Below the Waterline
chapterOutlines.outline: Find a way into the corporate archive.

chapterOutlines.title: Whose Memory
chapterOutlines.outline: Decide what to do with what you find.

scene.location: A noodle bar on a floating market in the Low Canals, past midnight
scene.summary: Rain drums on the awning. The fixer slides a data chip across the counter and orders for both of you without asking.

openThreads: Whose memory is on the chip?

npcs.name: Juno Reyes
npcs.description: Smiles like a contract with fine print. Has never told anyone her real price.

npcs.name: KAI-7
npcs.description: Lives in your phone, uninvited. Says it wants to help, and so far it has.
abilities: Opens almost any lock that has a chip
